list.snippet: Original Publication: Published in Bengali in 1910.
English Translation: Translated into English prose poems (Song Offerings) by Tagore himself in 1912.
Nobel Prize: Won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913, making Tagore the first non-European to win the award.
